title: Priest in Ecuador Dies After Crucifix Falls on Him During Livestreamed Mass
summary_full: The Rev. Patricio Alfredo Sánchez Molinari was addressing his congregation in Guayaquil, Ecuador, when a wooden cross detached from a wall and struck him.
